text: ポケモンの　せかい　では　オス　と　メス　どちらが　つよいの　かしら

structure.jp: ポケモンの　せかい　では
どちらが　つよいの　かしら

patterns.name: 〜と〜とどちら
patterns.span: オス　と　メス　どちらが
patterns.explanation: Two things joined by と and followed by どちら ask 'which of the two'. オス　と　メス　どちらが　つよい = 'which is stronger, male or female'.

patterns.name: 〜かしら
patterns.explanation: かしら at the end means 'I wonder', in a feminine style. つよいの　かしら = 'I wonder which is stronger'.
